title: Dark Energy
description: The energy of empty space itself, pushing galaxies apart.

puzzle.goal: A homogeneous universe expands with scale factor a(t) (a = 1 today). It contains matter diluting as a⁻³, radiation as a⁻⁴, spatial curvature k, and a constant energy of empty space Λ. Write the square of the expansion rate in terms of these.
puzzle.name: Friedmann equation with a cosmological constant
puzzle.ask: For a flat universe with negligible radiation, H = H0·√(Ωm/a³ + ΩΛ). Find the expansion rate when the universe was half its present size.
puzzle.method: Treat a comoving sphere's kinetic plus gravitational energy, or take the time-time component of the field equations for a homogeneous metric.
